skill_name: Create a 3-minute speech on why pursuing a college degree is important.
workflow:
Good morning everyone. Today, I'm here to share with you why pursuing a college degree is so important. 

First and foremost, college opens the door to more career opportunities. Many employers require at least a college degree in order to qualify for a job. A college degree demonstrates that you have learned a variety of information, have the intellectual capacity, and can take responsibility for studying a specific field of knowledge.
